# AlphaBoard

> AlphaBoard (alphaboard.xyz) is an independent, read-only analytics site for prediction markets. It focuses on Polymarket liquidity: liquidity-provider (LP) opportunities, maker reward farms, order-book spread and depth, plus trader leaderboards and wallet analytics. It also shows a read-only sample of Kalshi markets. Not affiliated with Polymarket or Kalshi. Not financial advice.

Data is fetched from public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs. Pages show when their data was retrieved; figures change continuously and reward programs are set by the platforms, not by AlphaBoard.

## Liquidity and LP rewards

- [Liquidity](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/liquidity): Polymarket LP opportunities, reward farms, spread and depth, and a maker reward simulator.
- [How to earn yield as a liquidity provider on Polymarket](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/blog/polymarket-lp-guide): guide to spread, depth, APR estimates and LP risks.
- [FAQ](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/faq): how the LP Score and APR estimates are calculated and what risks LPs carry.

## Markets

- [Markets explorer](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/markets): active Polymarket markets by volume, liquidity and closing time; a Kalshi view groups recently traded Kalshi markets by event with spread and displayed size.

## Traders and wallets

- [Leaderboard](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/leaderboard): top Polymarket traders by profit and volume.
- [Wallet checker](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/checker): P&L, win rate and trade history for a Polymarket wallet address.
- [Activity](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/activity): live Polymarket trade feed.
- [Insights](https://www.alphaboard.xyz/insights): market-wide trends.
